name: Women Outreach Cell
description:
At Women Outreach Cell, we believe every woman—regardless of her circumstances—deserves the chance to learn, grow, and thrive.

We work directly with women in rural areas and young girls from underprivileged backgrounds who are unable to afford an education.Through awareness drives, mentorship programs, and skill - building workshops, we inspire them to continue their studies, develop employable skills, and build a path toward financial independence.

achievements.title: 1st Position in Rangoli Competition, Landcraft Flower Show
achievements.desc: The Women Outreach Cell (WORC) team, including Bhoomi Sharma, Mansi, Radhika Saxena, Palak, and Harshita Malhotra, secured the First Prize in the Rangoli Competition at the Landcraft Flower Show & Chatkara Food Festival. The theme was 'Vande Mataram – 150 Years,' focusing on environmental protection.

events.title: Candle Making Program 'Udaan – Women Empowerment Mission'
events.desc: Organized a skill development training session in Basantpur Sainthly village to empower 50 rural women, enabling them to explore candle making as a potential source of income and entrepreneurship.

events.title: Handmade Rakhi Activity under Green Mission
events.desc: Conducted a creative activity at PM SHRI Composite Vidyalaya, Basantpur Sainthli, where 50 girls crafted rakhis from waste materials to promote recycling and sustainable living.

events.title: Special Counselling Session under Viksit Bharat
events.desc: A guidance session held at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Muradnagar, for over 50 students to help them identify inner strengths and nurture an entrepreneurial mindset.

events.title: Adolescent Health Programme for Girls
events.desc: Part of the Mission Shakti initiative, this program at Sir Chhotu Ram Kisan Kanya Inter College educated 100 girls on physical and mental health, hygiene, and personal safety.

events.title: Pickle Making Training for Women Employment
events.desc: A social initiative in Village Dwedha aimed at enhancing the financial independence of women from underprivileged communities and rural areas through vocational training.
